content:
The **Hocking Hills State Park** is a unmarked location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

A former state park in Ohio, it encompasses locations such as the Ash Cave. [1] 

Hocking Hills State Park appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

A real-world state park of the same name exists in Hocking County, Ohio.
